caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional, brown, house-shaped structure that resembles a miniature building or a mechanical bank. The structure features architectural details such as a shingled, gabled roof with a central chimney, decorative cornices, and three arched windows visible on two sides. The front of the house has a staircase leading to a small porch enclosed by a fence with ball-topped posts. To the left of the porch, there is a small dog figure facing a table under an arched entryway; a coin appears to be placed on this table. Attached to the right side of the house is a crank handle. On the upper right of the drawing, there are two detailed technical illustrations: one is a circular component adorned with a floral pattern and an attached lever, and the other is a side view of a horizontal mechanical assembly that includes a small standing human figure gripping a rod, with several gears and a crank handle, possibly illustrating the internal mechanism of the house structure. The colors used are predominantly brown, with shading to indicate depth and detail. The artist's signature "W.O. Fletcher" appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Toy Bank: Building and Revolving Dog
